q: How tall is the Eiffel Tower, to the tip of its antenna?
fact: The iron expands in summer heat, so the tower grows by up to 15 cm.

q: How tall is the Statue of Liberty, from the ground to the tip of the torch?
fact: The copper statue alone is 46 m; the rest is the pedestal and foundation.

q: How tall is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai?
fact: It has been the world's tallest building since 2010.

q: How tall is the Elizabeth Tower, home of Big Ben?
fact: Big Ben is really the name of the great bell inside, not the tower.

q: How tall is the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
fact: It started leaning during construction in the 1170s because of soft ground.

q: How tall is the Great Pyramid of Giza today?
fact: It was about 146 m when built, and was the tallest structure on Earth for nearly 4,000 years.

q: How tall is the Empire State Building, to the tip of its antenna?
fact: The roof is at 381 m; the spire was first designed as an airship dock.

q: How tall is the Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio, not counting its pedestal?
fact: Its outstretched arms span 28 m, almost as wide as it is tall.

q: How high is the top of the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch above the water?
fact: Locals call it 'the Coathanger'.

q: How tall are the Golden Gate Bridge's towers above the water?
fact: Its famous colour is called International Orange.

q: How tall is Seattle's Space Needle?
fact: It was built for the 1962 World's Fair.

q: How tall is the CN Tower in Toronto?
fact: It held the record for the world's tallest free-standing structure for 32 years.

q: How tall is the Tokyo Skytree?
fact: 634 can be read as 'Mu-sa-shi', the old name of the Tokyo region.

q: How tall is the Shanghai Tower?
fact: The building twists 120 degrees as it rises to reduce wind load.

q: How tall is Taipei 101?
fact: A 660-tonne steel ball inside sways to steady the tower in typhoons.

q: How tall are the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur?
fact: A skybridge links the two towers on the 41st and 42nd floors.

q: How tall is One World Trade Center in New York, including its spire?
fact: Its height is 1,776 feet, a nod to the year of US independence.

q: How tall is The Shard in London?
fact: It has 95 storeys and around 11,000 glass panels.

q: How tall is the Gateway Arch in St. Louis?
fact: It is exactly as wide at its base as it is tall.

q: How tall is the Washington Monument?
fact: The stone changes colour a third of the way up, where building paused for over 20 years.

q: How tall is each president's face on Mount Rushmore?
fact: About 90% of the carving was done with dynamite.

q: How tall is the Angel of the North sculpture in England?
fact: Its wings span 54 m, wider than a Boeing 757.

q: How tall is the London Eye?
fact: One full rotation takes about 30 minutes.

q: How tall is the tallest standing stone at Stonehenge, above the ground?
fact: Another 2 m or so of that stone is buried below ground.

q: How tall is the Arc de Triomphe in Paris?
fact: In 1919 a pilot flew a biplane straight through its arch.

q: How tall is the outer wall of the Colosseum in Rome?
fact: It could hold around 50,000 spectators.

q: How tall are the towers of London's Tower Bridge?
fact: Its roadway still lifts around 800 times a year to let ships pass.

q: How tall is Blackpool Tower?
fact: It was inspired by the Eiffel Tower and opened in 1894.

q: How tall is St Paul's Cathedral in London, to the top of its cross?
fact: It was the tallest building in London for over 250 years.

q: How tall is the Hoover Dam?
fact: It holds enough concrete to pave a road from San Francisco to New York.

q: How tall is the drop of Niagara's Horseshoe Falls?
fact: Around 2,800 cubic metres of water go over the falls every second.

q: How tall is Angel Falls in Venezuela, the world's tallest waterfall?
fact: The water falls so far that much of it turns to mist before reaching the bottom.

q: How high is the summit of Mount Everest above sea level?
fact: The mountain still rises by a few millimetres every year.

q: How high is Mont Blanc, the highest mountain in the Alps?
fact: Its height changes slightly every year with the depth of its ice cap.

q: How high is Mount Kilimanjaro?
fact: It is the tallest free-standing mountain in the world.

q: How high is Mount Fuji?
fact: It is an active volcano; it last erupted in 1707.

q: How high is Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the UK?
fact: Its summit is in cloud for most of the year.

q: How high is Table Mountain above Cape Town?
fact: The cloud that pours over its flat top is called 'the tablecloth'.

q: How high is the Matterhorn?
fact: Its pyramid shape inspired the Toblerone logo.

q: How high is Denali, North America's highest peak?
fact: From base to peak it is taller than Everest's rise above its own plateau.

q: How high is Mount Kosciuszko, mainland Australia's highest peak?
fact: You can walk to the summit on a path; no climbing gear needed.

q: How high does Uluru rise above the surrounding plain?
fact: Much more of the rock is hidden underground.

q: How tall is the cliff face of El Capitan in Yosemite?
fact: Alex Honnold climbed it without ropes in under four hours in 2017.

q: How tall is a large adult male giraffe?
fact: A giraffe's neck has seven vertebrae, the same number as yours.

q: How tall is an adult male African elephant at the shoulder?
fact: It is the largest land animal on Earth.

q: How tall is a large male ostrich?
fact: Its eyes are bigger than its brain.

q: How tall is an adult male polar bear standing on its hind legs?
fact: Under the white fur, a polar bear's skin is black.

q: How tall is an adult emperor penguin?
fact: It is the tallest of all penguins and can dive more than 500 m.

q: How tall is a large grizzly bear standing upright?
fact: Grizzlies can run at around 55 km/h.

q: How tall is a large bull moose at the shoulder?
fact: A moose's antlers can span 1.8 m and are shed every winter.

q: How tall is a typical Shire horse at the shoulder?
fact: Shires are among the biggest horse breeds in the world.

q: How tall is a large male red kangaroo standing upright?
fact: Red kangaroos can cover 8 m in a single hop.

q: How tall is an adult male Great Dane at the shoulder?
fact: On its hind legs, a Great Dane is taller than most people.

q: How tall is an adult male gorilla standing upright?
fact: Gorillas share around 98% of their DNA with humans.

q: How tall was a Tyrannosaurus rex at the hips?
fact: A T. rex skull alone could be 1.5 m long.

q: How tall was a Brachiosaurus, with its head held up?
fact: It could look into a fourth-floor window.

q: How tall is Hyperion, the world's tallest known tree?
fact: Its exact location in California is kept secret to protect it.

q: How tall was the record-breaking tallest sunflower ever grown?
fact: It was grown in Germany in 2014.

q: How tall is General Sherman, the giant sequoia?
fact: By volume it is the largest living single-stem tree on Earth.

q: How tall was Robert Wadlow, the tallest person ever recorded?
fact: He was still growing when he died, aged 22.

q: How tall is sprinter Usain Bolt?
fact: Coaches once thought he was too tall to be a great sprinter.

q: How tall is basketball legend Shaquille O'Neal?
fact: He wears size 22 US shoes.

q: How tall is the average adult man in the United States?
fact: The average American woman is about 1.62 m.

q: How tall is Taylor Swift?
fact: She is taller than most of the stars she shares stages with.

q: How tall is actor Tom Cruise?
fact: He does many of his own stunts, including hanging off a flying plane.

q: How tall is actor Danny DeVito?
fact: He voiced the Lorax in the 2012 film.

q: How tall is basketball star Yao Ming?
fact: Both of his parents were professional basketball players.

q: How tall was Napoleon Bonaparte?
fact: He was about average height for his time; the 'short' myth is mostly British propaganda.

q: How tall is actor Peter Dinklage?
fact: He won four Emmys for playing Tyrion Lannister.

q: How tall was Abraham Lincoln?
fact: He is the tallest US president to date.

q: How high is a regulation basketball rim off the floor?
fact: It has been 10 feet since James Naismith nailed a peach basket to a balcony in 1891.

q: How tall is a standard interior door in the US?
fact: That is 80 inches, the most common door height in North America.

q: How tall is a full-size football (soccer) goal?
fact: It is 8 feet tall and 8 yards wide, a leftover from imperial rules.

q: How high is a tennis net at its centre?
fact: It is slightly higher at the posts: 1.07 m.

q: How tall is a typical London double-decker bus?
fact: London buses are tilt-tested to 28 degrees without tipping over.

q: How tall is a classic red K6 British telephone box?
fact: Its domed roof was inspired by a tomb in a London churchyard.

q: How tall is a standard 20-foot shipping container?
fact: There are tens of millions of shipping containers in use worldwide.

q: How high is a men's volleyball net?
fact: The women's net is 2.24 m.

q: How high is the Olympic platform diving board?
fact: Divers hit the water at around 55 km/h.

q: What is the men's high jump world record?
fact: Javier Sotomayor set it in 1993 and nobody has beaten it since.

q: How tall is Michelangelo's statue of David?
fact: It was carved from a single block of marble that other sculptors had given up on.

q: How tall is each letter of the Hollywood sign?
fact: It originally read 'HOLLYWOODLAND' and advertised a housing estate.

q: How tall was the Saturn V moon rocket?
fact: It is still one of the most powerful rockets ever flown.

q: How tall was the Space Shuttle on the launch pad, with tank and boosters?
fact: The shuttle flew 135 missions between 1981 and 2011.

q: How tall was the Titanic, from keel to the top of its funnels?
fact: Its wreck lies about 3,800 m down in the North Atlantic.

q: How tall is a Boeing 747 at the top of its tail?
fact: That is about as tall as a six-storey building.

q: How tall is an Airbus A380 at the top of its tail?
fact: It is the largest passenger airliner ever built.

q: About how high above the Earth does the International Space Station orbit?
fact: It circles the Earth about every 90 minutes.

q: What is a typical cruising altitude for a passenger jet?
fact: That is about 35,000 feet, higher than Mount Everest.

q: How high is the Kármán line, often called the edge of space?
fact: Above it, the air is too thin for wings to give planes any lift.

q: How high was Felix Baumgartner when he jumped from a balloon in 2012?
fact: He broke the sound barrier during his freefall.

q: How tall was the biggest wave ever surfed, according to Guinness World Records?
fact: It was ridden by Sebastian Steudtner at Nazaré, Portugal.

q: How tall is India's Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue?
fact: It is about twice as tall as the Statue of Liberty with its pedestal.

q: How tall is 'The Motherland Calls' statue in Volgograd, including the sword?
fact: The sword alone is 33 m long.

q: How tall is the Atomium in Brussels?
fact: It is shaped like an iron crystal magnified 165 billion times.

q: How tall is the White Tower at the Tower of London?
fact: It was built by William the Conqueror in the 1070s.

q: How tall is the rebuilt spire of Notre-Dame de Paris?
fact: It was rebuilt to its 19th-century design after the 2019 fire.

q: How tall is Cologne Cathedral?
fact: It took 632 years to finish, from 1248 to 1880.

q: How tall is the Berlin TV Tower (Fernsehturm)?
fact: Sunlight on its ball makes a cross shape, nicknamed 'the Pope's revenge'.

q: How tall is the Ostankino Tower in Moscow?
fact: It was the world's tallest free-standing structure from 1967 to 1976.

q: How tall is the Chrysler Building in New York?
fact: Its spire was secretly assembled inside the building and raised in 90 minutes.

q: How high is the top of the Hagia Sophia's main dome?
fact: The building is almost 1,500 years old.

q: How tall is the Taj Mahal, to the top of its main dome?
fact: Its four minarets lean slightly outward so they would fall away from the tomb.

q: How tall is the Lotte World Tower in Seoul?
fact: It has a glass-floored observation deck called Seoul Sky on its upper floors.

q: How tall is Merdeka 118 in Kuala Lumpur, including its spire?
fact: It became the world's second-tallest building when it was finished in 2023.

q: How tall is the Makkah Royal Clock Tower in Saudi Arabia?
fact: Its clock faces are 43 m across, among the largest in the world.

q: How tall is the Willis Tower in Chicago, to its roof?
fact: Its glass 'Ledge' boxes stick out 1.3 m from the 103rd floor.

q: How tall is Tokyo Tower?
fact: It is painted white and orange to meet air-safety rules.

q: How tall is the Sky Tower in Auckland?
fact: Visitors can bungee-style 'SkyJump' from 192 m up.

q: How tall is the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel in Dubai?
fact: It stands on its own artificial island.

q: How tall is 'The Gherkin' (30 St Mary Axe) in London?
fact: Only one piece of its glass is curved: the lens-shaped cap on top.

q: How tall is the Flatiron Building in New York?
fact: At its narrowest point, the building is only about 2 m wide.

q: How tall is the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, including the statue on top?
fact: The chariot on top was taken to Paris by Napoleon in 1806 and returned in 1814.

q: How tall is the Trevi Fountain in Rome?
fact: Around €3,000 in coins is thrown into it every day and given to charity.

q: How tall is the seated statue of Abraham Lincoln in the Lincoln Memorial?
fact: If Lincoln stood up, the statue would be about 8.5 m tall.

q: How tall is the Great Sphinx of Giza?
fact: It was carved directly out of the bedrock of the Giza plateau.

q: How tall is Paro, the tallest moai statue ever stood upright on Easter Island?
fact: It weighs around 80 tonnes.

q: How tall is the Spring Temple Buddha statue in China, not counting its base?
fact: With its lotus throne and building beneath, it reaches 208 m.

q: How tall is the highest mast of the Millau Viaduct in France?
fact: It is taller than the Eiffel Tower and the tallest bridge in the world.

q: How tall are the towers of Japan's Akashi Kaikyō Bridge?
fact: Its central span is nearly 2 km long.

q: How tall is the Three Gorges Dam in China?
fact: It is the world's biggest power station by installed capacity.

q: How tall is Ain Dubai, the world's tallest Ferris wheel?
fact: It is almost twice as tall as the London Eye.

q: How tall is the High Roller Ferris wheel in Las Vegas?
fact: Each cabin can hold up to 40 people.

q: How tall was Kingda Ka in New Jersey, once the world's tallest roller coaster?
fact: It launched riders from 0 to 206 km/h in 3.5 seconds.

q: How tall is the Little Mermaid statue in Copenhagen?
fact: Many visitors are surprised by how small it is.

q: How tall is the Manneken Pis statue in Brussels?
fact: He has a wardrobe of over 1,000 costumes.

q: How high is Aconcagua, the tallest mountain in South America?
fact: It is the highest mountain outside Asia.

q: How high is K2, the world's second-highest mountain?
fact: It is nicknamed 'the Savage Mountain' because it is so dangerous to climb.

q: How high is Mount Elbrus, Europe's highest peak?
fact: It is a dormant volcano with two summits.

q: How high is Aoraki / Mount Cook, New Zealand's highest mountain?
fact: Edmund Hillary trained on it before climbing Everest.

q: How high is Olympus Mons on Mars, the tallest volcano in the solar system?
fact: It is so wide that from its summit the edges would be over the horizon.

q: How tall is Mauna Kea in Hawaii, measured from its base on the ocean floor?
fact: Measured this way, it is taller than Mount Everest.

q: How high is Mount Vesuvius?
fact: Its eruption in AD 79 buried the Roman city of Pompeii.

q: How high is Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon), the highest mountain in Wales?
fact: A railway has carried visitors to near the summit since 1896.

q: How tall is Victoria Falls on the Zambezi River?
fact: Its local name means 'the smoke that thunders'.

q: How tall is Yosemite Falls in California, counting all three sections?
fact: It often dries up completely in late summer.

q: How high are the Cliffs of Moher in Ireland at their highest point?
fact: On a clear day you can see the Aran Islands from the top.

q: How high are the White Cliffs of Dover at their highest?
fact: They are made of chalk built from the skeletons of tiny sea plankton.

q: How deep is the Grand Canyon at its deepest point?
fact: The Colorado River has been carving it for millions of years.

q: How tall can giant kelp grow?
fact: It can grow up to 60 cm in a single day.

q: How tall is a large adult emu?
fact: Emus can't walk backwards.

q: How tall is an adult okapi at the shoulder?
fact: Despite its zebra stripes, its closest relative is the giraffe.

q: How tall was Zeus, the Great Dane recorded as the tallest dog ever, at the shoulder?
fact: Standing on his hind legs he was over 2.2 m tall.

q: How tall was Big Jake, the record-holding tallest horse, at the shoulder?
fact: He was a Belgian horse from Wisconsin and weighed about 1,180 kg.

q: How tall can an adult male orca's dorsal fin grow?
fact: Females have a much shorter, curved fin.

q: How tall is a newborn giraffe?
fact: Baby giraffes are born with a 1.5 m drop to the ground and can stand within an hour.

q: How tall is a newborn African elephant at the shoulder?
fact: A newborn elephant weighs around 100 kg.

q: How tall is basketball legend Michael Jordan?
fact: He was cut from his high school varsity team as a sophomore.

q: How tall is LeBron James?
fact: He is the NBA's all-time leading scorer.

q: How tall is Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson?
fact: He played college football at the University of Miami.

q: How tall is Lionel Messi?
fact: As a child he needed growth hormone treatment.

q: How tall is Cristiano Ronaldo?
fact: He has scored more official goals than any other men's footballer.

q: How tall is actor Zendaya?
fact: She began her career as a Disney Channel star.

q: How tall was Queen Elizabeth II?
fact: She reigned for 70 years, longer than any other British monarch.

q: How tall is Sultan Kösen, the world's tallest living man?
fact: He also once held the record for the largest hands on a living person.

q: How tall is Jyoti Amge, the world's shortest living woman?
fact: She appeared in the TV series American Horror Story.

q: How tall is strongman Hafþór Björnsson, who played 'The Mountain'?
fact: He once deadlifted 501 kg.

q: How tall is singer Ariana Grande?
fact: She started out in the Broadway musical 13.

q: How high is a netball hoop?
fact: Unlike basketball, a netball hoop has no backboard.

q: How high is the crossbar on rugby union goalposts?
fact: The posts must be at least 3.4 m tall.

q: How tall are the stumps in cricket?
fact: That is 28 inches, a size fixed since the 1930s.

q: How high is a badminton net at its centre?
fact: A smash can send the shuttlecock flying faster than 400 km/h.

q: How high is a table tennis net?
fact: Table tennis was banned in the Soviet Union for years because it was thought to harm the eyes.

q: How tall is an ice hockey goal?
fact: That is exactly 4 feet tall and 6 feet wide.

q: How high is the highest Olympic springboard?
fact: Springboards are made of aluminium and bend to launch divers upward.

q: How high is the men's platform in the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series?
fact: Divers hit the water at around 85 km/h.

q: How tall is the Great Bell inside the Elizabeth Tower, known as Big Ben?
fact: It weighs about 13.7 tonnes and has a crack in it.

q: How tall is an Oscar statuette?
fact: During World War II, Oscars were made of painted plaster.

q: How tall is the FIFA World Cup trophy?
fact: It is made of 18-carat gold.

q: How tall is the Stanley Cup?
fact: Each player on the winning team gets to spend a day with it.

q: How high did Concorde usually cruise?
fact: It flew so high that passengers could see the curve of the Earth.

q: How high could the SR-71 Blackbird spy plane fly?
fact: It is still the fastest jet-powered crewed aircraft ever flown.

q: How high above the Earth do GPS satellites orbit?
fact: Each GPS satellite circles the Earth twice a day.

q: How high is a geostationary orbit above the equator?
fact: At this height a satellite circles once a day, so it seems to hang still in the sky.

q: About how far away is the Moon, on average?
fact: The Moon moves about 3.8 cm farther from Earth every year.

q: How tall is a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket?
fact: Its first stage flies back and lands upright so it can be reused.

q: How high was a Rüppell's vulture flying when it was hit by a plane, the highest bird ever recorded?
fact: Its blood has a special type of haemoglobin that works in very thin air.

q: How high is Everest's South Base Camp in Nepal?
fact: Climbers often spend weeks here getting used to the thin air.

q: How high above sea level is La Paz, Bolivia's seat of government?
fact: Its cable cars are the highest urban cable car network in the world.

q: How high above sea level is Denver, the 'Mile High City'?
fact: A step on the state capitol building marks exactly one mile up.

q: How high above sea level is Mexico City?
fact: The city is slowly sinking, by up to 50 cm a year in places.

q: How high above sea level is Lhasa in Tibet?
fact: Its name means 'place of the gods'.

q: How high is the top-floor observation deck of the Burj Khalifa ('At the Top Sky')?
fact: The building's lifts travel at about 10 m per second.

q: How high is the first floor of the Eiffel Tower?
fact: It has a glass floor so you can look straight down.
